This document lists the minor maintenance 
procedure P1, 
which must be performed every four years or 40.000 operation hours bases as indicated in the title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed El-Sabagh & eng. Adel Saad Zaghlool, 
 revised by eng. Mohamed selim & eng. Sobhy Abel Halim, accepted by general 
 manager eng. Mohamed Abd Elghaffar, and approved by Al Aresh PS Head Sector 
 eng. 
 The internet assistance by eng. Mohamed Selim.

A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.

items:
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
The equipment must be fully isolated mechanically and electrically.

Disconnect the suction and discharge flanges and oil and water piping 
 including the remove balancing line.
Remove the electric wires and remove all instruments.
Unscrew set screw from base plate.

Lift the pump. the ropes be not placed under the supports but involve the nut 
 of tie rods.

Remove the centering pins and the screw and dismantle the half upper support 
 case.
Remove the centering conical pins and remove the support case.
Remove the half lower bearing and labyrinth seal rings.
Re install the half coupling pump side.

Unscrew the locking screw of the balance drum tension bush and remove the 
 split ring then extract the balance drum.

Screw the locking screws of the drum tension bush, with draw it and remove the 
 split ring unscrew the locking screw of the spacer ring and remove the O 
 ring with draw the balance drum.
Unscrew the nut and extract the delivery.
Remove the stages and remove diffuses from inter stage.
Reassembly by performing the above reverse order.
Withdraw the shaft and remove the half coupling.
Remove the centering bins, the screws and upper half housing.

Sling the bearing housing bins loosing the centering screws unscrew the nuts 
 and with draw the housing.
Dismantle the suction casing avoid removing the chamber cover.
Check the condition of slide bearing.
Check the condition of thrust bearing.

text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the minor maintenance 
procedure P1, 
which must be performed every four years or 40.000 operation hours bases as indicated in the title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed El-Sabagh & eng. Adel Saad Zaghlool, 
 revised by eng. Mohamed selim & eng. Sobhy Abel Halim, accepted by general 
 manager eng. Mohamed Abd Elghaffar, and approved by Al Aresh PS Head Sector 
 eng. 
 The internet assistance by eng. Mohamed Selim.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Wear safety 
 helmet, safety shoes.
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Wear safety 
 helmet, safety shoes.
The equipment must be fully isolated mechanically and electrically.
Empty the pump completely.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Lifting ropes, Wooden blocks.
Cleaning fluids, Dial indicator.
Filler gauge, Rages.
Straight edge.
Item | Qty. | Remarks
Thrust 
 bearing | 1 | Imported
Slide 
 bearing | 2 | Imported
Balance drum | 1 | Imported
Spacer | 10 | Local 
 workshop
Shaft | 1 | Local 
 workshop
Mechanical seal | 2 | Imported
Work to be Carried Out
Disassembly
Disconnect the suction and discharge flanges and oil and water piping 
 including the remove balancing line.
Remove the electric wires and remove all instruments.
Unscrew set screw from base plate.
Lift the pump. the ropes be not placed under the supports but involve the nut 
 of tie rods.
Remove the centering pins and the screw and dismantle the half upper support 
 case.
Dismantle the lubrication screw pump.
Remove the centering conical pins and remove the support case.
Remove the thrust bearing.
Remove the half lower bearing and labyrinth seal rings.
Disassemble the mechanical seal.
Remove stuffing box.
Re install the half coupling pump side.
Unscrew the locking screw of the balance drum tension bush and remove the 
 split ring then extract the balance drum.
Screw the locking screws of the drum tension bush, with draw it and remove the 
 split ring unscrew the locking screw of the spacer ring and remove the O 
 ring with draw the balance drum.
Unscrew the nut and extract the delivery.
Remove the stages and remove diffuses from inter stage.
Reassembly by performing the above reverse order.
Withdraw the shaft and remove the half coupling.
Journal Bearing Disassembly
Remove the centering bins, the screws and upper half housing.
Sling the bearing housing bins loosing the centering screws unscrew the nuts 
 and with draw the housing.
Dismantle the suction casing avoid removing the chamber cover.
Reassembly
Check clearance of impeller.
Check the condition of slide bearing.
Check the condition of shafts.
Check the condition of thrust bearing.
Check oil pump gear.
Check collar.
Chick the weld spots.
Chick the sealing ground surface.
Chick the hydraulic circuit.
All gaskets should be replaced.
After Reassembly when the 
Pump operates
Check the vibration.
Check the Oil pressure & temperature.
Check the Pressure and quantity of discharge.
Check the Motor Ampere.
Check the 
 Bearing temperature.

sections_ar.text: يوضح هذا المستند إجراء الصيانة الصغرى P1، الذي يجب تنفيذه كل أربع سنوات أو كل 40.000 ساعة تشغيل طبقًا لما هو موضح بجدول العنوان

أعدّ المسودة الأولى المهندس أحمد الصباغ والمهندس عادل سعد زغلول، وراجعها المهندس محمد سليم والمهندس صبحي عبد الحليم، وقبلها مدير عام المهندس محمد عبد الغفار، واعتمدها رئيس قطاع محطة العريش، بمساعدة المهندس محمد سليم.
يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة،
يلزم إقامة سياج أمان (حبل) وعلامات تحذير حول منطقة العمل.

items: يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة،
يلزم إقامة سياج أمان (حبل) وعلامات تحذير حول منطقة العمل.
يجب عزل المعدة تمامًا ميكانيكيًا وكهربيًا.
افصل فلانشات السحب والطرد ومواسير الزيت والمياه بما فيها خط الاتزان البعيد.
انزع الأسلاك الكهربية وانزع جميع الأجهزة.
فك مسمار التثبيت من قاعدة التثبيت.
ارفع الطلمبة. يجب ألا توضع الحبال تحت الدعامات بل حول صامولة قضبان الربط.
انزع مسامير التمركز والمسمار وفكّك النصف العلوي لعلبة الدعم.
انزع مسامير التمركز المخروطية وانزع علبة الدعم.
انزع النصف السفلي للكرسي وحلقات مانع التسرب المتاهي.
أعد تركيب نصف القارنة من جهة الطلمبة.
فك مسمار قفل جلبة شد طبلة الاتزان وانزع الحلقة المشقوقة ثم استخرج طبلة الاتزان.
اربط مسامير قفل جلبة شد الطبلة، واسحبها وانزع الحلقة المشقوقة، وفك مسمار قفل حلقة المباعد وانزع حلقة O واسحب طبلة الاتزان.
انزع المراحل وانزع الناشرات من بين المراحل.
أعد التجميع بتنفيذ ما سبق بالترتيب العكسي.
انزع مسامير التمركز والمسامير والنصف العلوي للبيت.
علّق بيت الكرسي بعد فك مسامير التمركز، وفك الصواميل واسحب البيت.
فكّك غلاف السحب وتجنب نزع غطاء الغرفة.
